title: Document batch workflow and update agent skills
description: Document the completed batch contract after CLI behavior is final. Update README everyday workflow and CLI reference with CSV/JSON export-edit-import examples, selectors, format inference, stdin/stdout, required updatedAt stale protection, JSON version 1 shape, CSV blank-preserves plus _clear semantics, atomic all-or-nothing behavior, and the distinction from canonical root export. Update wtp help and wtp schema with exact commands, response shapes, editable fields, validation rules, and the transient .wtp/meta/batch-update.json recovery journal. Update CONTRIBUTING task-backlog guidance and the Unreleased changelog. Add the journal to this repository's .gitignore beside wtp.lock. Update skills/task-management/SKILL.md to instruct agents to prefer focused batch export/import over generated PowerShell scripts or repeated task update calls. Update skills/setup-wtp/SKILL.md and the README history-worktree recipe so version-controlled stores ignore both transient files. Keep skill text concise, imperative, and within its existing scope; do not add new skill folders or helper scripts. Run the skill validator on both changed skills, documentation contract tests, go test ./..., and git diff --check.
